steps.content: [Scene] Live Stage, Empty
A single spotlight cuts through the dark. A girl with snow-white wings descends to the center of the stage. Yet beyond that beam of light, not a single star shines.
Empty seats. Hollow stares. A silent venue... No applause, no screaming, no...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...Where is everyone? My Cherubs... where did you all go?
The smile she has practiced countless times freezes. Right now, she is not a radiant idol. She is an object on a stage. A forgotten piece of merchandise.
Thud. The pink light stick slips from her hand. It shatters on the vast stage floor, the noise echoing through the empty venue.

In the very next moment, the shards become falling bottles and cans, and the echoes churn into a chaotic storm. She stumbles back two steps in disbelief, desperate to flee the stage as it collapses around her.
But it's too late. Dark crimson thorns burst through the floor, flooding her vision in an instant, coiling around her ankles, her wrists, then her throat, one after another.
[Scene Change] Shackles Effect + Shattered Glass Effect
[Scene Change] Trash Heap CG + Color Shift Effect

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Why...
[Scene Change] Bureau Ceiling

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Who... am I...?
[Scene Change] Bureau Command Room 1

MBCC Command Room
Several Days After Phanuel's Concert
A dozen large screens are on all at once, pouring every last drop of the outside world's noise and fury into the command room.

Playing on every screen are stories related to Phanuel. Reporters cycle across the displays, each one talking faster than the last, as if slowing down means losing ratings. Calling them news reports would be generous. A trial by public opinion would be much more accurate.

steps.speaker: Reporter 1
steps.content: ...According to our reporters' investigation, Phanuel, an idol under Mirrormoon Entertainment, is suspected of having cooperated with the company in carrying out psychic manipulation. The number of known victims continues to rise, and relevant authorities have yet to issue an official response...

steps.speaker: Reporter 2
steps.content: ...Exclusive scoop! A family member of a Hollow Syndrome patient breaks down in tears outside the Public Security Bureau, demanding a full investigation into Phanuel and the entire Mirrormoon Entertainment supply chain. Just what has this father been through? Are his tears real? We staked out for three days to get this footage. Watch...

steps.speaker: Reporter 3
steps.content: ...Fans are turning their backs on her en masse! The <color=#fb9259>#PunishPhanuel</color> hashtag has already surpassed 100,000 views on social media! What are you waiting for? Repost to serve justice! Like to show your stance! Phanuel must pay the price!

Comments stream across the screens from right to left, too fast for the eyes to catch more than fragments. <color=#fb9259>"Fake Angel," "leech who exploits her fans," "give me back my hard-earned money, Phanuel"</color>... along with an overwhelming flood of censored expletives.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Information has been spreading much faster on social media than expected. Quite a few fans managed to film the events of that day, and between the real and the fabricated footage, over 200 different versions have been circulated already. The Bureau has been working around the clock alongside the Public Security Bureau's cyber unit to control the situation, but we aren't quite able to keep up with the netizens...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Word of Phanuel being brought to the Bureau has gotten out, Chief. Every party involved is now putting pressure on us.
Before Nightingale can finish asking, you've found the answer on Phanuel's fan app.
The top post reads: "Your Angel idol has been taken in by the legendary Mi*** Bureau of Crisis Control. Nothing to see here, folks." Posted just minutes ago, but it already has 999+ replies.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Hard to say. It could be the Public Security Bureau, perhaps even a reporter or fan who was there. Either way, the fact remains that this information is already out and cannot be contained. However, there's something even more pressing.
Nightingale pulls up another page.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Families of Hollow Syndrome patients have launched a joint petition, demanding Phanuel be handed over to the judiciary for a public trial. So now, even the city council has started sending inquiries. Chief, we need to act quickly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How's Phanuel doing?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Her M-value is relatively stable, but...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It seems she's lost her memory.

Phanuel sits in silence, neither curious nor afraid. She's nothing like the other Sinners who come here for the first time. The way she carries herself, you'd think she was here for a perfectly ordinary interview. It's almost like she's seated not on a cold interrogation chair, but a plush velvet sofa.
Just days ago, she was Eastside's hottest idol. But now, the person sitting across from you is nothing more than a suspect.
[Flashback] Bureau Surveillance Room

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The doctor has performed a medical check-up already. Physically, she's fine. Mentally, though... she's forgotten her own name, along with everything that happened to her. All that remains are a few hazy fragments. The doctor suspects that her mind has shut part of itself down as a protective measure.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: To make matters worse, any attempt to question her causes a sharp spike in her M-value. The Public Security Bureau gave up after that. If we want to get any leads off of her, you're our only shot, Chief.

You flip through the case report, its edges worn from being handled so much. Forty-seven confirmed Hollow Syndrome patients so far, and the number is still climbing. There's no way a small agency with just one artist and one manager could pull this off. Someone was backing them.

But before Phanuel could be apprehended, her manager Eliza turned up dead under mysterious circumstances. Their mansion was searched top to bottom, but nothing turned up beyond everyday personal effects and fan gifts. Every clue has been wiped clean. If the trail that is Phanuel goes cold too, then so will the case.
[Flashback] Interrogation Room

You look up. The pretty doll across from you doesn't react to your presence at all. That model smile of an angel is frozen on her face, and even her posture is angled so that only her best side is shown.

She seems to have genuinely forgotten you. Is the amnesia a coincidence? Some kind of post-trauma defense mechanism? Or is it a failsafe put in place by whoever's pulling the strings? Either way, this interrogation is your only hope.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The situation is urgent, which is why we had to bring you in. The interrogation can be stopped at any time. Let me know immediately if you feel uncomfortable.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: That's fine. Let's start.
Her voice is soft, like chilled sparkling water on a summer day, sweet and effervescent.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you remember who you are?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: No. But they told me my name is Phanuel, and that I'm an idol.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Wynn said my dress is really pretty, and that my hair looks nice too. So... I must've been a popular idol, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you know where you are, and why you're here?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: No... When I opened my eyes, I was already here. There are white walls everywhere, and a lot of people in uniforms. Is this a hospital?
She tilts her head with a blank look, as if fishing for something familiar in the murk of her memory.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But the way they look at me... they seem scared. So I must have... done something wrong, right? Am I under arrest? Are you the one in charge here... the big boss, Chief?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm sorry... Wynn told me that too.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: There are a few fragments here and there, but I can't recall anything about you, or what happened on that day. And even if I try to, my head starts to hurt, like it's getting stabbed.
She raises her hand and gently rubs her temple.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But you do appear in my memories. You feel very... familiar. I feel safe with you. We must have shared something memorable, right?

<color=#fb9259>Something memorable?</color> Well, getting played for a fool by a top idol, eloping in the scorching summer, making a promise that belongs to the two of you alone, only to be stabbed in the back at the very end of the mission is, in a way, memorable, you suppose.
And in response to your conflicted expression, Phanuel only blinks with an innocent look. You offer no further explanation and press on.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How much do you remember about yourself?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm... an angel who brings love and happiness to everyone. That's my purpose. It's why I exist.
As she speaks, her voice takes on a reverent tone, her fingers drifting up to trace the winged heart ornament on her chest.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I live in a very tall and big room. There are floor-to-ceiling windows in that room, and an entire wall of mirrors.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Every day, from morning to night, I'd practice my smile in the mirror. I'd practice how to do the perfect wave, practice every little fan-service gesture. I can't stop, because many people are waiting for me...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Looks like you remember the industry jargon just fine. What about before you became an idol?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: There is nothing <color=#fb9259>before</color> that.
Her tone is matter-of-fact, as if your question is inconceivable.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel is Phanuel. I exist to heal everyone, to be their salvation.

Phanuel's file only glosses over her life before she became a trainee. No one knows her past, and now it seems even she herself has long forgotten it. Or perhaps... You shelve the question for now, marking that gap in her history with a question mark.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What can you remember about your agency, <color=#fb9259>Mirrormoon Entertainment</color>?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Mirrormoon Entertainment... I don't know...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: All I know is that when I smile, everyone becomes happy. That's why I do my best... Wait, I think... someone's calling my name? I hear so many voices... No, that's my fans cheering... That's not it either...
Her breathing quickens, her words dissolving into incoherent rambling. The M-value monitor in the interrogation room lets out a few soft warning beeps.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop. Don't force yourself.
Phanuel takes a slow, deep breath and gradually steadies herself. She lifts her head, eyes faintly red, and looks at you with an apologetic expression.

You open the report and slide one of the pages toward her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you recognize any of these people?

Phanuel follows your finger and looks through the photos one by one. A vacant-eyed young girl, a man in glasses slumped over the desk, an agent in a business suit... But she shakes her head at every single one.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're a Sinner, Phanuel. Your power is extremely dangerous. It drains your fans' mental energy, leaving them in the same state as these people. All the evidence points to you, but...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Based on our prior interactions, I'm inclined to believe you were being used by your manager and company. If you know something, be it about how the company operates, who's pulling the strings behind the scenes, or what their goals are, tell me. Anything works.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: While MBCC detains Sinners, we also protect them. Come clean, cooperate with the investigation, and your sentence will be significantly reduced.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm sorry... I really can't remember anything more.
Pushing Phanuel right now may not be the wisest move, but time is running short. The sooner she remembers something, the better your chances of catching Phantom Entertainment in the act.
[Flashback] Play several Event CG images here

You flip through the investigation report, sliding image after image in front of her. A grand concert. A sea of light sticks stretching as far as the eye can see. And her, beneath the spotlight, flawless, a magnum opus.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've forgotten now, but I faced you when your Mania went out of control. Within that storm, I saw you, and together, we heard certain things.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those words changed you, shaped you. I watched as a pure, innocent little doll was turned, step by step, into a faceless mannequin before a shop window.
There's a subtle shift in the Mania fluctuations in the air.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You say you don't remember, and I want to believe you. But the fact that I could perceive those images means they haven't truly vanished. They're just buried somewhere deep inside you.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I don't know... Please, don't push me any further...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Memories are interconnected. You may have forgotten temporarily, but all it takes is finding the right edge to pry it open...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: STOP!!!
Her voice erupts in the interrogation room. Her breathing turns ragged, her chest heaving. The sudden outburst catches you off guard.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I don't know what you saw, but I don't remember anything... Why does everyone keep asking me about things I can't remember? If I can't remember something, that means it wasn't important. That means it shouldn't exist!
She wraps her arms around herself, and the shackles connecting her to you begin to shake violently.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Everything I know about my past, someone else told me. They said I was an idol. They said I was a tool for the company. Tools don't have memories. Tools don't need to know who they are. They just need to be used.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Tell me then, Chief. What am I supposed to remember? Ask questions, and I'll answer. Tell me what to do, and I'll do it. Is that okay?

As if echoing her helplessness and turmoil, the girl's M-value spikes rapidly. The lights in the interrogation room flicker, and even your own emotions begin to waver under the influence of her power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Calm down, Phanuel. I just need you to regain your memories as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I don't know what to do. I don't know who I am. I don't know what I'm supposed to say... You tell me, Chief. You tell me what to do.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I won't resist. I won't run. I'll cooperate. Just tell me what to do...

The girl before you grows increasingly frantic and unhinged. She clutches your arm desperately, like someone who's drowning. Words are useless now. You reach over, grab her by the wrist, and activate the shackles without hesitation.
[Release the shackles]

A harsh red light flashes. The Mania is suppressed, and the shadow behind Phanuel's eyes slowly clears. Unfortunately, the damage to her psyche remains. Even as she returns to her senses, she still clings to you, desperate for a direction.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Tell me... what should I do... please...
She settles back into the chair, hands folded obediently on her knees. Though her eyes are still red, they're completely vacant, just like the Hollow Syndrome patients in the photos.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I got a little too hasty. That's enough for today. Go get some rest.
The interrogation room door clicks shut. You let out a sigh and sink back into your chair.
She knows nothing about the case. Maybe she really is nothing more than a pawn, just as you suspected. No one's even attempting to silence her, after all.

Did Phantom Entertainment wipe her memories? Or was the shock of falling from heaven to hell simply too much for her to bear? Maybe she's a far more skilled actress than she lets on, and even you, who's no stranger to losing your own memories, couldn't see through her?
Nightingale's avatar flashes rapidly on your portable terminal. You tap open a video link, and a handful of top-liked comments jump out at you.

options: ...The real culprit is shifting the blame.

choices.text: ...The real culprit is shifting the blame.

steps.content: The Bureau, which should have stayed under the radar, has been thrust into the public eye. The focus of the incident has shifted, and the outrage is now aimed squarely at the Bureau. You can't allow public opinion to spiral out of control.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for her—
In the photos scattered across the desk, Phanuel's smile looks divine and radiant. But her eyes, just like today, hold no trace of warmth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's just wait and see.
